title: Matte Black 2 BD Condo - Music Row - Guitar Pool!
description:
MATTE BLACK 2 BD condo that sleeps 6 & directly on Nashville's Famous MUSIC ROW! This historic condo complex is located in the heart of Midtown & has the one & only iconic guitar-shaped pool!

* HeiarLivin Nashville Vacation Rentals has 10 properties in downtown Nashville. 

* If you have any questions on price or booking multiple properties, PLEASE SEND US A MESSAGE. We're happy to work with you! ALSO, we like to book 3 nights on the weekends but just message us & we'll try to work with you.

The space
This is our 2 BEDROOM condo that sleeps 6 comfortably. It was designed & decorated with a very CLEAN, MATTE BLACK & SLEEK VIBE! The attention to detail is portrayed throughout the entire place & is truly one of a kind in the building!

Bedroom 1:  Queen Bed (sleeps 2)

Bedroom 2:  Queen Bed (sleeps 2)

Common Area:  Queen Sleeper Sofa w/ memory foam mattress (sleeps 2)

MAIN:
The sleek matte black kitchen opens up into the living room. The kitchen has all NEW black slate appliances & is stocked with the essentials to cook a small meal if you'd like. The kitchen island has 4 bar stools for plenty of seating. The living room has a very cozy feel for you to relax & enjoy.

BATH:
Floating matte black double vanity sink & DOUBLE GLASS SHOWERS - embrace yourself as we designed two glass showers next to each other to maximize on efficiency in the bathroom. One private toilet in the bathroom.

The condo will be professionally cleaned before you arrive. We provide shampoo, conditioner, hand soap, dish soap, dishwasher detergent, garbage bags, one roll of paper towels, 3 rolls of toilet paper & laundry detergent. There are fresh towels in the bathroom, as well as extra blankets & pillows. The WiFi network & password will be on the Welcome Note on the counter.

ENJOYABLE AMENITIES:
* 24 hour keyless access with personal key code
* High speed Wifi
* Smart TV in living room
* Controllable thermostats
* Full length mirrors
* Hotel luxury bedding & linen
* Pillow-top mattresses
* Mr Coffee maker
* Full kitchen with new appliances, dishes, glassware & silverware
* Community pool & grill
* Pool towels 
* Washer & dryer
* Free parking; one parking pass per condo

POOL and GRILL:
The pool area is open year round.

PARKING:
Covered parking provided on the premise with the included parking pass. This pass must be on the dash of your vehicle at all times. One parking spot per condo. Additional street parking is available right across the street in front of the condo complex.

LOCATION:
Directly on Music Row in Midtown! Just a 15 minute walk to Broadway or a quick 5 minute Uber. Wonderful safe area with plenty of bars and restaurants right out your door!

Guest access
All our listing information is accurate and up-to-date. Upon booking, you’ll receive timely communications regarding your stay. Guests will have access to the entire 2 bedroom condo.

Each guest is given their own unique key code the day of arrival for easy, seamless access to check-in. Our keyless entry offers guests a higher level of security & more convenience not having to meet me for check-in/exchange keys at any certain time. We try our best to accommodate check-in if you let me know prior to your trip. Each request will be accommodated depending on the availability.

Check-in: 4:00 PM CST or after
Check-out: 11:00 AM CST or before
